requiredFindings.title: Freeze inspectable receipt-decision controls
requiredFindings.detail: The frozen artifact contains only nine case labels, passed booleans and blindInvocations: 0. It supplies no synthetic inputs, expected and observed decisions, executable control source, provenance, or binding to the reviewed wrapper hash, and no other subject member constructs or executes the cases. The wrapper branch is coherent by source inspection, but the claimed nine controls cannot be independently verified as executions of receipt_ready, sequencing, ordinary-error stopping and final eligibility.
requiredFindings.suggestedChange: Freeze an import-safe pure control source and detailed result bound to the exact wrapper SHA-256. Record each case's synthetic input, expected outcome, observed outcome, invocation counts and eligibility, and regenerate the subject without running a blind mode or accessing a store/cache.

exact-main.detail: Exact product main, accepted metadata lineage, subject/self/interpreter/input guards and detached clean worktree procedure reconcile.

combined-batch.detail: The current public bindings equal the exact union of C1b-0, C1c-0, C1b-1, C1b-2 and native materialization accepted deltas over the 0772 baseline.

fallback.detail: Unaccepted C2b-0 and C1c-1 are correctly excluded; later integration opens another interval.

expected-row-outcomes.detail: The executable branch enforces the requested discovery equality, companion allowed statuses, stop conditions and post-run eligibility on inspection, but the claimed nine synthetic control executions are not independently inspectable from the frozen subject.
